Hello players, this update is as follows:

1. Improved the image quality a little, improved the texture quality.
2. Added highlight effect when the character is obscured.
3. Added some special effects to improve performance.
4. Integrated with the latest DLSS3.5, Nvidia low latency mode and FSR2.2 (FSR3 did not announce SDK, may find AMD cooperation).
5. Deleted the Lumen software light chase, because for our game with a overlooking Angle and no complex light effect, the picture quality is not much improved, but the performance consumption is particularly high.
6. Fixed some hidden bugs found by programmers.
7. Removed the stat bonus for players with different copy difficulty.
8. Other mechanisms and numerical adjustments.

notes.title: "Story Of Infinity: Xia" Update
notes.content:
[h2]To all warriors:[/h2]

[Story of Infinity:Xia] has been updated on steam on April 21th, 2023. Welcome to download and experience! In order to make you familiar with the game as soon as possible, the updated content is announced as follows:

1.Redesigned the Sprint[Space] skill: Now the Sprint skill consumes Sprint points. When you have enough Sprint points, you can perform multiple Space movements and dodges.
2.Two new basic attributes have been added to the character's attributes: Sprint points and Sprint recovery rate.
3.Fixed the problem of speed resetting to zero after using Sprint[Space].
4.Optimized the pickup judgment for Weapons, Secret book, and Five-Elements Treasures, making it easier to click.
5.The Tao Law page has added a give up function, but it still consumes Five-Elements Treasures.
6.Lowered difficulty: a campsite that can be used for recovery has been added to the second level of the dungeon.
7.Adjusted the materials required to upgrade Elements Energy.

The above content can help you to explore adventure, We wish you a happy trip!


YOUGU Studio
